verification_command: .venv/bin/python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; p=Path('data/results/phase4-memory-relay/calibration/result.json'); r=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert r['status'] in {'completed','completed_with_inconclusive','cap_reached'}; print(r['status'],r['calibration_digest'],r['result_digest'])"
resume_command: if test -f data/results/phase4-memory-relay/calibration/result.json && .venv/bin/python -c "import json; assert json.load(open('data/results/phase4-memory-relay/calibration/result.json'))['status'] in {'completed','completed_with_inconclusive','cap_reached'}" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; if test -r /proc/2702938/cmdline && tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/2702938/cmdline | grep -Fq -- '--run-calibration'; then exit 0; fi; setsid bash .planning/async-jobs/04-12-calibration-v4-active.launch.sh >> data/results/phase4-memory-relay/calibration.launch.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
